plan.description: The plan you wrote before you built, in a few lines: what changes, where, and what proves it. The review reads it against the change, and a plan the work went past without saying so is a finding.

pages.description: The e2e pages the change touches, each by the name `npm run e2e -- --pages <name,…>` takes: the check runs those. Empty when the change touches no page of the board.
